title: Version 1.49.0
body:
Version 1.49.0 (💘 Valentines Day~!)

February 14th, 2024

Added:

  • Added number splitter, and number combiner to Alan's Autologistics!
  • The following content is limited time for 2 weeks:
  • Brought back the Rose and Sakura in their item form
  • Brought back Teddy and Valentines balloons
  • Introduced a new Lovely Moai in Fungi Finds
  • New Heart Hanging Lights are available at Illumine Designs

Changed:

  • Removed classic materials

Version 1.49.1

February 19th, 2024

Changed:

  • Made Xbox zoom controls more intuitive

Fixes:

  • Patched grabby grabber teleport glitch
  • Patched tool emote speed glitch
